channels.name: Incoming Booking Calls & Siren
channels.description: Continuous siren and ringtone alert for newly received booking requests.
channels.notes: flagInsistent causes the audio to repeat continuously like an incoming phone call until accepted or dismissed.

androidNativeCodeSnippet.kotlin:
val soundUri = Uri.parse("android.resource://" + context.packageName + "/raw/alert")
val audioAttributes = AudioAttributes.Builder()
    .setContentType(AudioAttributes.CONTENT_TYPE_SONIFICATION)
    .setUsage(AudioAttributes.USAGE_NOTIFICATION_RINGTONE)
    .build()
val channel = NotificationChannel("new_booking_alerts_v2", "Incoming Booking Calls & Siren", NotificationManager.IMPORTANCE_HIGH).apply {
    description = "Continuous siren alert for newly received booking requests."
    enableVibration(true)
    vibrationPattern = longArrayOf(0, 800, 400, 800, 400, 800, 400, 1200)
    setSound(soundUri, audioAttributes)
    lockscreenVisibility = Notification.VISIBILITY_PUBLIC
}
val notificationManager = context.getSystemService(NotificationManager::class.java)
// Delete old channel if exists to force sound update
notificationManager?.deleteNotificationChannel("new_booking_alerts")
notificationManager?.createNotificationChannel(channel)
